messages.subject: Charged twice for March invoice
messages.body:
Hi,

Our card was charged twice for invoice INV-2103 ($1,240.00) on March 3rd — I can see both charges on the statement. Can you refund the duplicate?

Dana Whitfield
Finance, Northwind

messages.body: Following up — it's been three days and the duplicate $1,240 charge is still on our card. If this isn't resolved this week I'll have to dispute it with the bank.

messages.subject: SSO login loop for 400-seat org
messages.body: Since this morning our users are stuck in a redirect loop between Okta and your login page. ~400 seats affected. Our TAM said to mark this urgent — happy to jump on a call.

messages.subject: Feature request: webhook retries
messages.body: Not urgent — it would be great if failed webhooks retried with backoff instead of dropping. We currently poll to compensate.

messages.subject: How do I rotate API keys?
messages.body: Hi! Is there a way to rotate our API keys without downtime? We have a security review next week.

messages.subject: Re: How do I rotate API keys?
messages.body: Hi Sofia — yes: create a second key under Settings → API, deploy it, then revoke the old one. Both keys stay valid during the overlap, so there's no downtime. Guide: https://docs.acme.dev/keys#rotation
